samples.summary: Out-of-diff error emitters still print multi-line pretty JSON, breaking the one-line stderr envelope contract this change now asserts and documents
samples.evidence: The change makes `outputError` emit a single line and the new test asserts `expect(raw).not.toContain('\n')` (packages/cli/test/output.test.ts:151), while README/design now state "a single JSON line on stderr" (packages/cli/README.md:116, docs/design/cli.md:1017). But many reachable error paths never go through `outputError` and still emit `JSON.stringify(..., null, 2)`: packages/cli/src/commands/docs.ts:195 and :255, packages/cli/src/commands/slides.ts:154 and :204, packages/cli/src/commands/notes.ts:148 and :203, packages/cli/src/commands/schema.ts:33, packages/cli/src/files/upload.ts:185/:217/:227, packages/cli/src/files/download.ts:57, packages/cli/src/slides/import.ts:152/:194/:237/:254/:311, packages/cli/src/notes/import.ts:120/:159/:188. A caller that adopts a line-delimited stderr parser because the contract now promises one line per error will fail on `docs content` / `slides import` / `files upload` failures. (The task note at docs/tasks/active/20260811-cli-error-envelope-command-todo.md:19-22 scopes these to #654/#655, so this may be a knowingly-accepted gap, but the docs/tests now state the contract unconditionally.)

samples.summary: Hand-rolled envelopes omit the new `command` field, so attribution is present for some failures of a command and absent for others
samples.evidence: `schema.ts:32-38` emits `{error:{code:'NOT_FOUND',message}}` with no `command`, as do the forwarded upstream bodies at packages/cli/src/commands/docs.ts:195, slides.ts:204, notes.ts:148 and the import/upload helpers. An agent driving several calls (the stated motivation for `command`) gets attribution only on the `outputError` paths, so it cannot rely on the field being present per failure.

samples.summary: Agent-facing skill/docs examples still show the old envelope (no `command`, pretty-printed), now inconsistent with the emitted shape
samples.evidence: packages/cli/skills/docs-read-content.md:86 and packages/cli/skills/docs-import-docx.md:57 show `{ "error": { "code": ..., "message": ... } }` with no `command`; docs/design/cli.md:770-778 shows the envelope pretty-printed across multiple lines while §9 (docs/design/cli.md:1017) now says a single JSON line; packages/documentation/developers/cli.md:264 also shows the bare shape. These are the documents agents read to build parsers.

samples.summary: `runCli` now mutates the caller-supplied `program` by registering a `preAction` hook on every invocation
samples.evidence: packages/cli/src/cli.ts:61 registers a hook on the passed-in `program`. `runCli(program, argv)` is an exported API used with caller-owned programs (packages/cli/test/output.test.ts:405+); invoking it twice on the same `Command` accumulates duplicate hooks, and the hook stays attached to a program the caller may reuse for other parses. Harmless today (the hook only assigns a variable) but it is a new side effect on a shared object.

verdict.reason: Verified independently. `outputError` (packages/cli/src/output/formatter.ts:80-93) now emits an unindented single-line envelope and its comment asserts the line-delimited contract; test/output.test.ts:151 asserts `not.toContain('\n')`; README.md:116-118 and docs/design/cli.md:1017-1018 state "a single JSON line on stderr" unconditionally. Meanwhile numerous reachable error branches bypass `outputError` entirely and still print pretty JSON: commands/docs.ts:195 and :255, commands/slides.ts:154 and :204, commands/notes.ts:148 and :203, commands/schema.ts:32-38, files/upload.ts:217/:227, files/download.ts:57, slides/import.ts:194/:237/:254, notes/import.ts:159/:188/:212, plus docs/import.ts:164/:194/:211 (not even listed by the reviewer). Each sets process.exitCode=1 and returns before the try/catch that would call outputError (e.g. docs.ts:213), so no guard renders them unreachable — they fire on ordinary HTTP failures where the backend returns an `{error:{code}}` body. A consumer adopting a line-delimited stderr parser on the strength of the now-documented, now-tested contract will mis-parse these multi-line envelopes. The task note at docs/tasks/active/20260811-cli-error-envelope-command-todo.md:19-22 defers them to #654/#655, but that is repo prose, not a guard, and the shipped docs/tests state the contract without qualification. Minor line-number drift in the evidence (upload.ts:185, slides/import.ts:152/:311, notes/import.ts:120) does not change the substance. Violated invariant with reachable out-of-diff violators = in-lane and blocking at major.
